1.w: My son, do not forget my instruction, and let your heart keep my commands.

2.w: For length of days and years of life and peace they will add to you.

3.w: And do not let loving devotion and faithfulness forsake you; bind them around your neck; write them on the tablet of your heart.

4.w: And you will find favor and good understanding in the eyes of God and man.

5.w: Put your trust unto YHWH with all your heart, and lean not unto your own understanding.

6.w: In all your ways acknowledge Him, and He will make straight your paths.

7.w: Do not be wise in your own eyes, fear YHWH and turn away from evil.

8.w: Healing it will be to your navel, and refreshment to your bones.

9.w: Honor YHWH from your wealth, and from the first of all your produce,

10.w: and your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

11.w: My son, do not despise the discipline of YHWH, and do not be grieved by His reproof,

12.w: for whom YHWH loves, He reproves, even as a father the son he is pleased with.

13.w: Blessed [is] the man [who] has found wisdom, and the man [who] brings forth understanding,

14.w: for better [is] the profit from her than profits of silver, and her produce than fine gold.

15.w: Precious she [is] above rubies, and all your delights do not compare with her.

16.w: Length of days [is] in her right hand, [and] in her left hand [are] wealth and honor.

17.w: Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, and all her paths [are] peace.

18.w: A tree of life she [is] to those taking hold on her, and those grasping her are blessed.

19.w: YHWH by wisdom founded the earth; He established the heavens by understanding;

20.w: by His knowledge the depths have been broken up, and the clouds dripped dew.

21.w: My son, do not do let them depart from your eyes; keep watch over wisdom and discretion,

22.w: and they will be life for your soul, and grace for your neck.

23.w: Then you will walk your way in safety, and your foot will not stumble.

24.w: If you lie down, you will not dread; and you have lain down, and your sleep shall be pleasant.

25.w: Do not be afraid from sudden dread, and from the desolation of the wicked when it comes.

26.w: For YHWH is at your flank, and He will guard your foot from capture.

27.w: Do not withhold good from its owners, with it being in the power of your hand to act.

28.w: You must not say to your neighbor, “Go and return, and tomorrow I will give”—and it is with you.

29.w: Do not devise evil against your neighbor, for he is dwelling in trust with you.

30.w: Do not strive with a man without cause, if he has not dealt with you [for] evil.

31.w: Do not be envious of a man of violence, and do not choose any of his ways.

32.w: For a perverse one [is] an abomination [to] YHWH, and with the upright [is] His secret counsel.

33.w: The curse of YHWH [is] on the house of the wicked one, but the abode of the righteous He blesses.

34.w: If He mocks at those mocking, then He gives favor to the humble.

35.w: The wise will inherit honor, and fools are held up [to] disgrace.
